comparison.objective: Refit a foam engine air-filter element so it seals around its perimeter; candidate breaks and recovers rigid metal tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Compliant-element seating and perimeter seal formation versus rigid fine-tool alignment, impact fracture, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Filter fully seated with an all-round seal versus four safe notch fractures and complete tang containment.
comparison.reason: Different material behavior and assembly outcome. Body/specs are absent, leaving seal tolerances and deformation/damage criteria unspecified.
